name: Imaging Biometrics Ltd.
summary: Imaging Biometrics Ltd., founded in 1965 and headquartered in Saint Helier, Jersey, specializes in medical imaging diagnostics and clinical patient care. The company extends its services across the United Kingdom, Switzerland, the European Union, and the United States. Its operations are structured into three main segments: a Holding Company, Medical Software, and Oral Gallium Maltolate (GaM). The Medical Software division develops a comprehensive suite of ready-to-use software applications for the healthcare sector. This portfolio includes IB Clinic, which serves as the foundational platform for all IB software; IB Neuro, a specialized platform for MR DSC perfusion processing; and IB Delta Suite, designed to generate Delta T1 maps from routine MR examinations. Further offerings comprise IB DCE and IB Diffusion, both providing in-depth insights into blood flow and water diffusion throughout the body. For non-invasive assessments, the company provides StoneChecker and Liver Surface Nodularity, which are computed tomography (CT) processing tools that assist clinicians in evaluating kidney stones and liver health. Additional software includes IB ASL, used to measure cerebral blood flow for diagnosing conditions like stroke and dementia, and IB Zero G, an innovative technology that eliminates the need for gadolinium contrast agents in standard imaging. The suite also features IB Nimble, facilitating virtual collaboration among healthcare professionals. Beyond software, the company's Oral Gallium Maltolate (GaM) segment is actively pursuing the development of IB003, a gallium maltolate drug candidate currently in Phase 1 clinical trials for treating glioblastoma. Imaging Biometrics Ltd. also offers consulting services. The entity, which was previously known as IQ-AI Limited, is slated to adopt the name Imaging Biometrics Ltd. in May 2025.
